destinationPostalPrefix.description: Destination postal prefix (never a full address); the same validation as the quote.

tiers.description: Tiers to estimate; the four classic tiers when omitted. CONSOLIDATED is refused with 422 validation-failed: it is a persistent-offer tier, quoted on POST /delivery-quotes (ADR 0024).

items.description: The items of one listing view, each catalogItemId once; each is estimated on its own.
